text: Acceptance 2: disabling an actor leaves its wake webhook active and sends new private content. In-memory test with injected delivery: setWake(Bob), setDisabled(Bob,true), then post a private @bob mention => wakeable=true and sent=['@bob synthetic content after disabling']. No network request was made. Check actors.disabled_at in isWakeable and immediately before dispatch; disabling must stop outbound deliveries.
